en.title: Advancing Players in Each Round of an Adjacent Knockout
en.description:
Adjacent pairs of players compete, and the one with the smaller rank number advances. When a round has an odd number of players, the last one advances automatically. Output the list after each round, keeping the original match order, until only one player remains; do not output the initial list.

This site has made the standard input and output explicit; any range not given by the source is marked as this site's protocol.
en.input: The first line contains n, and the second line contains n distinct ranks. The source gives no numeric ranges; on this site 1≤n≤200000 and 1≤rank≤10⁹.
en.output: The first line is the number of rounds R; then one line per round, giving the number of advancing players followed by their ranks.
en.explanation: Example 1: the three rounds are 1 3 5 7, 1 5, and 1. Example 2: in the first round 1 beats 3 and 2 gets a bye, giving 1 2; in the second round 1 advances. Example 3: only one player remains from the start, so there are no knockout rounds; output 0 rounds.
hints: In each round take the minimum of each pair, keep the unpaired element as is, record the new list, and continue.
